slots.name: age at death
slots.sentence: Carlos Garcia, a New York activist and organizer known as Chino, whose fight to save the thriving community center that he co-founded was emblematic of a larger struggle against the gentrification of New York City, died on July 24 at his home in Manhattan. He was 80.

slots.name: birth date
slots.sentence: Carlos Garcia was born on May 27, 1946, in Rio Piedras, Puerto Rico, one of several children of Carlos Luis Garcia, a construction worker who became a waiter after the family moved to New York in 1951, and Antonia (Fuentes) Garcia, a garment worker who was active in the International Ladies’ Garment Workers’ Union.
